headline: VisionQuest creator breaks down finale twists
post:
Hey Marvel fans! The Phase 6 series "VisionQuest" has officially wrapped up its emotional run on Disney+. According to Screen Rant, showrunner Terry Matalas recently opened up about those massive finale twists. Matalas explained that bringing Joe Locke's Billy back for the final episode was carefully timed to keep the focus strictly on the family reunion. 

We also got some great insight into how Paul Bettany and James Spader took on multiple roles to build a deep backstory exploring generational trauma. Sadly, Kathryn Hahn could not make a cameo appearance as Agatha, because Matalas joked, "We can't afford Kathryn Hahn!" 

What did you think of the epic finale?

headline: Jack Kirby and Stan Lee: the real history
post:
For decades, Stan Lee served as the face of Marvel Comics, but his relationship with co-creator Jack Kirby was famously complicated. According to Screen Rant, tension began way back in the 1940s at Timely Comics, long before they revolutionized the industry with The Fantastic Four and shaped heroes like The Avengers, the X-Men, and the Hulk. 

While Stan Lee became the celebrated public face and hype man, Kirby felt his overall writing and plotting contributions were minimized. Matters grew worse when disputes over creators' rights and original artwork sparked massive legal and public battles that lasted for years. 

What are your thoughts on how classic comic book credits are shared? 💭

#MarvelHistory #JackKirby #StanLee
original_title: Why The Avengers' Co-Creator Ended Up Hating Stan Lee

headline: Howard the Duck piece hits auction
post:
Before the Marvel Cinematic Universe took over Hollywood, the 1986 live-action Howard the Duck movie famously struggled at the box office and almost ended Marvel's film ambitions. Now, a piece of its creature design created by stop-motion master Phil Tippett is heading to auction.

Heritage Auctions has an original Dark Overlord Marquette up for sale alongside items from Star Wars, Jurassic Park, and more. Bids for the sculpted head of the alien from the film's final act are currently at $1,000.

Would you bid on this movie piece?

#HowardTheDuck #Marvel #PhilTippett
original_title: Before the MCU, Howard the Duck Nearly Derailed Marvel Movies, and Now a Piece of Its Creature Design Is Up for Auction
